en.title: Rusty Lungs and the Grave Marker of Lies
en.premise: Rain doesn't fall from the sky—it's rust dust that gnaws at your lungs. I wander the dying city as a scavenger who scrapes junk, clutching a dwindling oxygen canister. One day I meet a junk‑boy cursed to never be able to tell a lie, and a lost AI that drifts through fragments of memory. While evading the law‑enforcement apparatus hunting them, I come to realize that the world’s end is actually built upon a colossal lie.

zh.title: 锈蚀的肺与谎言的墓碑
zh.premise: 从天而降的不是雨，而是磨蚀肺部的锈粉。我作为废品搜寻的拾荒者，紧握着所剩无几的氧气罐，在这座垂死的城市中徘徊。某日，我遇到了被诅咒“永不能说谎”的废品少年，以及在记忆碎片中徘徊的迷失人工智能。躲避追捕他们的治安维持机构的追踪时，我意识到，所谓的世界终结，竟是建立在一场宏大的谎言之上。
